title: Lofn Studio Knobs preset
description: A *.knobs.yaml file (plan §3.2). Every magic number becomes a parameter with a range, a derivation, and invariants. `expr` values are evaluated by a tiny SAFE evaluator (int arithmetic + ceil/floor/min/max only — never eval()). `gates_key` binds a knob to a vault/gates.yaml key so the run-local gates materializer can override it.

name.description: Human name for the preset, e.g. 'classic-6x4'.

invariants.description: Boolean expressions over knob names. A violation renders inline in the Knobs UI and BLOCKS Run (not Compile).

knob.description: A knob has EITHER a literal `value` OR a derived `expr` (not both required, but at least one). Scalars and 2-element bands are both valid values.

value.description: Literal default. A number, boolean, or a [lo, hi] band.

expr.description: Derivation over other knobs, e.g. 'ceil(n_pairs / 2)'. Evaluated by the safe evaluator. A derived knob may still be pinned via `override`.

min_expr.description: A lower-bound expression the value must satisfy, e.g. '2 * n_pairs'. Surfaced as an invariant.

override.description: For a derived knob: a literal that pins the value, ignoring `expr`. null = use expr.

range.description: [min, max] the UI slider clamps to (inclusive).

gates_key.description: vault/gates.yaml key this knob writes when materializing the run-local gates.yaml.
